stem:
Lilah reads 5 books every month. The table shows the total number of books Lilah reads over time.

Lilah’s Reading

| Number of Months | Books Read |
|------------------|------------|
| 2                | 10         |
| 4                | 20         |
| 6                | 30         |

Complete the sentence to describe the relationship in the table.

Choose the correct answer from each drop-down menu to complete the sentence.

The number of months [blank_1] [blank_2] is equal to the number of books Lilah reads.
